strings.cutscene.intro.1:
The city took seven days to write.
On the eighth, the tide came.
strings.cutscene.intro.2:
Ink does not kill.
It crosses things out.
strings.cutscene.intro.3:
You have a blade left,
and one clean page.
strings.cutscene.intro.4:
Reach the First Stroke
before it is erased.
strings.cutscene.finale.1:
The First Stroke held.
The seal broke, and the names became lines again.
strings.cutscene.finale.2:
But the tide was already in the hall.
Ink rose to the knees, then to the chest.
strings.cutscene.finale.3:
Someone holds a pen above the city.
The next page is not written yet.
strings.dialogue.archivist.name: THE OLD COPYIST
strings.dialogue.archivist.1: You are late, Scribe. The tide is already in the Archive.
strings.dialogue.archivist.2: The Keeper is no villain. He is a guardian who was broken. He erased his own name — and now erases everything else.
strings.dialogue.archivist.3: A blade will not stop him. Take the brush. It hits harder and breaks the seal.
strings.dialogue.archivist.4: The seal on his chest is the last place the First Stroke still holds. Strike there.
strings.dialogue.archivist.5: Go. I will stay while the ink lasts.

strings.controls.title: SETTINGS
strings.controls.touch_note: Drag each control and adjust its size individually. Positions adapt to the screen and safe area. To strike upwards, hold the stick or D-pad up and press Attack. You can strike downwards while airborne.
strings.controls.key_note: Select an action, then press a key or mouse button. Esc always goes back.
strings.controls.pad_note: Select an action, then press a button or trigger. B / START go back from settings.

strings.controls.capture_hint: Waiting for input: 8 seconds · Esc: cancel · Existing assignments will be replaced

strings.guide.title: Controls in the game
strings.controls.bind_note: Select an action to change its binding.
strings.controls.capture_note: Waiting for input: 8 seconds. Existing bindings will be replaced.
strings.controls.layout_note: Drag each control and adjust its size individually. Layout respects the screen proportions and safe area.
strings.guide.step.move: Use %s to move left and right.
strings.guide.step.jump: Press %s to jump over an obstacle.
strings.guide.step.attack: Press %s to swing the blade. Aim up, or down while airborne.
strings.guide.step.dash: Press %s for a quick dash. You can dash in the air too.
strings.guide.step.heal: Hold %s on the ground to heal using collected ink.
strings.guide.step.swap: After unlocking the brush, press %s to switch weapons.
strings.guide.step.pause: Press %s to open pause and settings.
strings.guide.touch.move: Drag the left stick to move. With a floating stick, start a touch anywhere in the left movement area.
strings.guide.touch.jump: Tap the highlighted button to jump over an obstacle.
strings.guide.touch.attack: Tap the highlighted button to swing the blade. Use the stick to aim.
strings.guide.touch.dash: Tap the highlighted button for a quick dash, including in the air.
strings.guide.touch.heal: Hold the highlighted button while grounded. Healing spends collected ink from the flask.
strings.guide.touch.swap: After unlocking the brush, this button switches weapons.
strings.guide.touch.pause: Tap the highlighted button to open pause and settings.
strings.guide.touch.move_dpad: Press a side of the highlighted D-pad to move in that direction.
